title: Solutions by industry | Alai Labs
description: Robots, edge AI and industrial IoT for ports, public cleaning, facility management, waste, manufacturing, infrastructure and occupancy monitoring.

head.p_1: The same robots, edge AI and sensors, put to work on the problems of seven industries. Pick yours.

industries.p_1: Track assets across the terminal, keep cranes working and cut fuel use, with sensors and edge AI that run on site.
industries.p_2: Clean streets and public spaces when they need it, not on a fixed round, using cameras on trucks and a robotic arm that does the work.
industries.p_3: Keep restrooms clean through the whole cycle with a cleaning robot your team can watch and control remotely in a 3D view.
industries.p_4: Know which bins need emptying, spot illegal dumping and hazardous waste, and plan collection routes from live data.
industries.p_5: Bring Industry 4.0 to the factory floor with connected machines, digital twins and mobile robots you can run remotely.
industries.p_6: Find corrosion, cracks and leaks on vehicles and mobile structures early, before they turn into failures.
industries.p_7: See how spaces are used, how people move through them and where assets are, from tags and sensors with machine learning.
